question: Can a 9-slot dormant key-value memory preserve synthetic cue-to-response capability across inactivity, and does memory become harmful when the same cue's target changes?
hypothesis: Read-enabled nine-slot dormant memory should improve recall of previously observed returning motifs under stable targets relative to a cache-write-matched sham, but storing past targets may impose a plasticity cost after abrupt target reassignment.
freeze: Fix exact target SHA256 generator, conditions, switch episode, cohort, capacities, feedback sequence, outcome criteria and budget before first-use; retain all outcomes including negative/harm.
new_domain: 16 synthetic motifs with 4-valued observed targets; this is associative recall, not the old graph assignment churn objective. Active sets of 7 from frozen Y030 SHA256 keyed motif generator. Each episode observes only seven labels AFTER predicting.
conditions: STABLE: target for each seed/key=first SHA256('Y033/'+seed+'/'+key) byte mod4 throughout 12 episodes
SWITCH: same initial targets, but from episode6 onward target=(initial+2)%4 for every key, unknown to both policies until observed
arms: write_matched_sham: 7 previous-active key/value observations remain immediately available, nine inactive cache entries still written and evicted but may not be read
dormant_memory_read: exact same seven previous-active observations and nine inactive writes, plus may read cached values of returning dormant motifs
prediction_feedback: On each of 12 episodes, predict target for each of 7 current active keys using only previous observed current/dormant memory, default guess0 when unknown. Then reveal exactly those 7 episode labels as feedback and update memory. No labels for inactive keys, future episodes or policy selection.
storage: At most seven previous-active key/value pairs and nine dormant key/value pairs, never more than 16 total. Distinguish active/live associations from dormant memory; each episode cache updates apply symmetrically and cache writes counted equally.
primary: For heldout STABLE compute correct predictions, returning-dormant accuracy and sham-read difference. For SWITCH record same metrics split pre/post episode6, particularly first stale dormant recalls; STABLE_DORMANT_RECALL if stable read beats sham total and there are more correct dormant read predictions; STABILITY_PLASTICITY_TRADEOFF if stable read beats sham and switched post-change dormant read correctness falls below stable counterpart; OTHERWISE_MIXED if no criterion. Outcome categories not mutually exclusive: record both boolean findings.
independent_checks: Targets derived by evaluator only when feedback occurs, no target formula in predictor. 8 distinct SHA256 keyed input fingerprints, cache occupancy/writes parity, deterministic double run, exact pinned blobs and one full regression.
claim_limit: Procedural finite symbolic associative recall with observed feedback; no semantic or natural-language consolidation, no clinical/neuroscience claims, no accepted ref mutation.
